The following files exceed 100MB and may be candidates for archival:

{{ $input.all().map(i => `• ${i.json.name} (${i.json.sizeMB}MB) - Owner: ${i.json.owner}`).join('\n') }}

parameters.content:
### Drive Large File Alert and Cleanup
Weekly scan of Google Drive for files over 100MB. Reports findings to a Sheet, emails the file owner with a list, and suggests archival for storage optimization.
